title: Agent
description: A named AI actor of the BSS: whose rights it runs with, what it may read, which governed actions it may check and execute, which model calls it makes, and how autonomous it is.

kind.description: assistant = answers a person; copilot = proposes and a person applies; classifier = reads and labels; autonomous = acts on its own within a contract; external = an agent outside the BSS using the MCP door

runsAs.description: caller = the signed-in person's own token and rights; machine:<client> = a machine account

badge.description: the realm role bundle this agent's machine account is granted when it is hired (e.g. digital-worker). Required when runsAs is a machine AND the agent declares executable actions: ops/arch/agent_badge_check.py proves every declared action is actually permitted by this badge's roles, so the registry cannot claim powers the token does not carry.

uses.description: AI use cases it makes — every one governed, metered and audited by the intelligence component

component.description: the component whose code it lives in

contract.description: the learning contract or policy that bounds it

memory.description: what it remembers between calls, and where
